title: Collateral Schedule
description: Collateral Schedule contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-fs-collateral-schedule
  title: Collateral Schedule
  description: Collateral Schedule contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
  version: fs_collateral_schedule_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: fs/collateral_schedule
    sourcePath: Schemas/fs/collateral_schedule
    sourceVersion: fs_collateral_schedule_v1
    sourceDigest: 07be3349fde413a2085ba74d15594aa043c0c7a7d5b3b642772230774eb115aa
spec:
  documentType: collateral_schedule
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - appraisal-date
        - schedule-date
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - agreement-reference
        - insurance-required
        - valuation-method
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - advance-rate-percent
        - borrowing-base-amount
        - prior-liens-amount
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - borrower-name
        - lender-name
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - collateral-category
        - collateral-description
        - collateral-items
        - collateral-location
        - eligible-collateral-value
        - total-collateral-value
    - id: risk-and-compliance
      title: Risk And Compliance
      description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - lien-position
        - perfection-method
  fields:
    - id: schedule-date
      name: schedule_date
      label: Schedule Date
      description: Date of schedule.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/schedule_date
    - id: borrower-name
      name: borrower_name
      label: Borrower Name
      description: Borrower or owner of collateral.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/borrower_name
    - id: lender-name
      name: lender_name
      label: Lender Name
      description: Secured party or lender.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/lender_name
    - id: agreement-reference
      name: agreement_reference
      label: Agreement Reference
      description: Loan/security agreement referenced.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/agreement_reference
    - id: collateral-category
      name: collateral_category
      label: Collateral Category
      description: Accounts receivable, inventory, equipment, real estate, deposit accounts, securities, vehicles,
        mixed, or other.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/collateral_category
    - id: collateral-description
      name: collateral_description
      label: Collateral Description
      description: General description of collateral.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/collateral_description
    - id: collateral-location
      name: collateral_location
      label: Collateral Location
      description: Location of collateral if stated.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/collateral_location
    - id: total-collateral-value
      name: total_collateral_value
      label: Total Collateral Value
      description: Total stated value.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/total_collateral_value
    - id: eligible-collateral-value
      name: eligible_collateral_value
      label: Eligible Collateral Value
      description: Eligible value after exclusions/reserves.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/eligible_collateral_value
    - id: advance-rate-percent
      name: advance_rate_percent
      label: Advance Rate Percent
      description: Advance rate percentage.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/advance_rate_percent
    - id: borrowing-base-amount
      name: borrowing_base_amount
      label: Borrowing Base Amount
      description: Borrowing base amount.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/borrowing_base_amount
    - id: appraisal-date
      name: appraisal_date
      label: Appraisal Date
      description: Appraisal or valuation date.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/appraisal_date
    - id: valuation-method
      name: valuation_method
      label: Valuation Method
      description: Appraisal, book value, market value, invoice value, NADA, or other.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/valuation_method
    - id: lien-position
      name: lien_position
      label: Lien Position
      description: First priority, second priority, subordinated, unknown, or other.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/lien_position
    - id: prior-liens-amount
      name: prior_liens_amount
      label: Prior Liens Amount
      description: Amount of prior liens if stated.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/prior_liens_amount
    - id: insurance-required
      name: insurance_required
      label: Insurance Required
      description: Whether insurance is required or referenced.
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/insurance_required
    - id: perfection-method
      name: perfection_method
      label: Perfection Method
      description: UCC filing, possession, control agreement, title lien, mortgage, or other.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/perfection_method
    - id: collateral-items
      name: collateral_items
      label: Collateral Items
      description: Item-level collateral entries with item_id, description, value, location, serial_number, vin, or
        account_number_masked when present.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/collateral_items
  validationRules:
    - id: borrower-name-present
      severity: error
      description: Collateral schedule must identify the borrower or collateral owner.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: borrower_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: borrower_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: borrower_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(borrower_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: collateral-description-present
      severity: warning
      description: Collateral description is required to use the schedule.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: collateral_description
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: collateral_description
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: collateral_description IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(collateral_description)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: collateral-value-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: Collateral value cannot be negative.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: total_collateral_value
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: total_collateral_value
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: total_collateral_value IS NULL OR total_collateral_value >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: advance-rate-range
      severity: warning
      description: Advance rate should be between 0 and 100 percent.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: advance_rate_percent
          - op: and
            rules:
              - op: gte
                left:
                  field: advance_rate_percent
                right:
                  value: 0
              - op: lte
                left:
                  field: advance_rate_percent
                right:
                  value: 100
      sourceExpression: advance_rate_percent IS NULL OR (advance_rate_percent >= 0 AND advance_rate_percent <= 100)
      supported: true
    - id: collateral-items-array-valid
      severity: warning
      description: Item-level collateral should be represented as an array.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: collateral_items
          - op: gte
            left:
              length: collateral_items
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: collateral_items IS NULL OR JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(collateral_items) >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      borrower_name:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Borrower identity links collateral to the credit facility.
      collateral_category:
        minConfidence: 0.86
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Collateral category determines monitoring and perfection controls.
      total_collateral_value:
        minConfidence: 0.93
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Collateral value affects borrowing base and exposure coverage.
      borrowing_base_amount:
        minConfidence: 0.93
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Borrowing base amount controls availability.
      lien_position:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Lien priority is central to secured credit risk.
      collateral_description:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Required field for Collateral schedule extraction.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 4096
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Collateral schedules may include tables, asset identifiers, valuation methods, lien position, and
      borrowing base calculations.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      schedule_date:
        type: date
        description: Date of schedule.
        format: date
      borrower_name:
        type: string
        description: Borrower or owner of collateral.
      lender_name:
        type: string
        description: Secured party or lender.
      agreement_reference:
        type: string
        description: Loan/security agreement referenced.
      collateral_category:
        type: string
        description: Accounts receivable, inventory, equipment, real estate, deposit accounts, securities, vehicles,
          mixed, or other.
      collateral_description:
        type: string
        description: General description of collateral.
      collateral_location:
        type: string
        description: Location of collateral if stated.
      total_collateral_value:
        type: number
        description: Total stated value.
      eligible_collateral_value:
        type: number
        description: Eligible value after exclusions/reserves.
      advance_rate_percent:
        type: number
        description: Advance rate percentage.
      borrowing_base_amount:
        type: number
        description: Borrowing base amount.
      appraisal_date:
        type: date
        description: Appraisal or valuation date.
        format: date
      valuation_method:
        type: string
        description: Appraisal, book value, market value, invoice value, NADA, or other.
      lien_position:
        type: string
        description: First priority, second priority, subordinated, unknown, or other.
      prior_liens_amount:
        type: number
        description: Amount of prior liens if stated.
      insurance_required:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether insurance is required or referenced.
      perfection_method:
        type: string
        description: UCC filing, possession, control agreement, title lien, mortgage, or other.
      collateral_items:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            asset_id:
              type: string
              description: Unique asset, collateral, VIN, serial, parcel, or internal identifier.
            asset_type:
              type: string
              description: Collateral type such as equipment, inventory, receivable, vehicle, real estate, cash, or
                securities.
            asset_description:
              type: string
              description: Specific asset or collateral description.
            owner_name:
              type: string
              description: Owner or pledgor of the asset.
            location:
              type: string
              description: Physical or custodial location of the asset.
            value_amount:
              type: number
              description: Stated value for the asset.
            valuation_date:
              type: date
              description: Date of valuation or appraisal.
              format: date
            lien_position:
              type: string
              description: Lien priority for the asset.
            perfection_status:
              type: string
              description: Perfected, unperfected, pending, expired, or unknown perfection status.
            insurance_status:
              type: string
              description: Insurance coverage status if stated.
        description: Item-level collateral entries with item_id, description, value, location, serial_number, vin, or
          account_number_masked when present.
    required:
      - borrower_name
      - collateral_description
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: commercial_lending
    outputContract:
      fields_object: extracted_fields
      confidence_object: confidence
      metadata_object: extraction_metadata
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - borrower_name
          - collateral_description
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - financials
          - parties
          - property_or_asset
          - risk_and_compliance
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields:
          - collateral_items
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
